_README: Every line the AI says when the language model is not consulted -- because
it is switched off, because this exchange is below the immersion level, or
because the turn's budget ran out. Edit freely; nothing here is compiled in.
A key maps to either a plain string, or a list of variant groups. Each group
holds interchangeable 'lines' and may carry a 'when' that has to hold for the
group to be eligible. The most specific eligible group wins, and one of its
lines is chosen at random, so the same interaction stops reading identically
every time. A group with no 'when' is the catch-all and should come last.
Conditions ('when'), all optional and all answered from the turn's snapshot:
at_war      true | false                    -- are the two of us fighting
opinion     'hostile' | 'cold' | 'warm'     -- what we think of them
A condition naming a list matches if any entry does: {"strength": ["weaker", "even"]}.
Placeholders: {target} in NOT_AT_WAR, {action} in the three GENERIC keys.

lines: You choose your moment well, knowing we cannot answer in kind.
We are the weaker party and you knew it. That is the whole of your courage.
You will find that a small nation cornered is not a cheap one.
You have picked a fight with the larger army. We accept.
This will be brief, and it will not go the way you imagine.
We had no quarrel with you. You will regret correcting that.
You will regret this betrayal.
So it is war. We will remember who began it.
Very well. Let the matter be settled in the field.
We know what we are outmatched by. We march regardless.
Better to fall on our feet than live on our knees.
Our claim does not become smaller because your army is larger.
Your occupation of our rightful territory ends now.
Withdraw, or be withdrawn. Those are the terms.
You have held what is ours for long enough.
Your occupation of our rightful territory ends now!
We have exhausted every other means. The army marches.
This has been coming for some time. Now it has come.
We have lost enough. We ask you to stop.
Name terms we can live with and this ends today.
We could continue. We would rather not. Stand down and so will we.
There is nothing further we need from this war. Let it end.
We offer terms for a ceasefire.
Neither of us is winning this. Let us stop pretending otherwise.
Enough. We propose the guns fall silent.
We propose terms while we still have terms to propose.
This war has cost us more than it can ever return. We sue for peace.
This war has cost us both too much. We propose terms.
Let us write an ending before one is written for us.
We are ready to talk, if you are ready to listen.
Between friends, an exchange that suits us both.
We have what you lack, and you have what we lack. Shall we?
We need not like each other to find this arrangement useful.
Commerce, nothing more. Read the terms.
We propose an exchange to the benefit of us both.
A straightforward trade, if it interests you.
Our stores and yours are unevenly filled. We propose to fix that.

ACCEPT_TRADE: We gladly accept your trade offer.
Agreed. The goods will move at once.
REJECT_TRADE: This trade is unacceptable to us.
You ask too much for too little.
We decline. Bring us something nearer to fair.
ACCEPT_PEACE: We accept your terms. The war between us is over.
It is agreed. Let the guns stop.
Signed. May neither of us need this again.
ACCEPT_MILITARY_ACCESS: We accept your request for military access.
Your columns may pass. See that they only pass.
PROACTIVE_JOIN_WAR: May we join you in your war?
Your enemies are ours. Let us fight them together.
PROACTIVE_JOIN_FACTION: Our enemies are aligned, let us join your faction to stand against them.
We would rather stand inside your bloc than alone outside it.
PROACTIVE_CREATE_FACTION: We propose establishing a new faction together.
Neither of us is aligned. Together we would be harder to swallow.
PROACTIVE_CALL_TO_ARMS: We request your aid in our ongoing conflicts!
The pact is being tested. Honour it.
PROACTIVE_REQ_MILITARY_ACCESS: As we both fight against a common foe, we request military access through your territory.
We share an enemy. Let us share a road to reach them.
PROACTIVE_FACTION_INVITE: Our cause would be stronger with you in it. Join us.
There is a seat at our table, if you want it.
ALLIANCE_BROKEN: So much for our word to one another.
FACTION_ABANDONED: We will not forget your abandonment.
You walked out. That will be remembered.
FACTION_DISBANDED: It is a shame to see our alliance broken.
So the pact is dust. A waste.
KICKED_FROM_FACTION: We will not forget being expelled from the alliance.
ACCEPTED_HELP: We gratefully accept your assistance in our conflicts.
Your help is welcome and will be repaid.
ANSWERED_CALL: We will answer your call to arms.
BREAK_ALLIANCE: Our alliance is at an end.
REQUEST_JOIN_WARS: We request permission to join your ongoing wars.
FOLLOW_UP_DECLARATION: Following through on our previous declaration.
INVITE_IGNORED: Your faction invitation was ignored and has expired.
JOIN_REQ_IGNORED: Your request to join the faction was ignored and has expired.
CEASEFIRE_IGNORED: Your ceasefire offer was ignored and has expired.
CALL_TO_ARMS_IGNORED: Your call to arms was ignored and has expired.
CANT_JOIN_FACTION: We cannot join a new faction while we are already bound to our own treaties.
NOT_AT_WAR: We would offer military aid to {target}, but they are not currently at war.
REJECT_JOIN_WAR_NO_ALLIANCE: We wanted to join your wars, but our lack of formal alliance prevents it.
CROSS_FACTION_JOIN: Our requests crossed paths. We are now united!
CROSS_CALL_TO_ARMS: Our diplomats crossed paths. We stand together in all our wars!
CROSS_WAR_DECLARATION: Your diplomat proposing a {action} was executed. We are at WAR!
ACCEPT_FACTION_ALREADY_IN: We wanted to accept, but we are already in a faction.
ACCEPT_FACTION_JOIN_ALREADY_IN: We cannot accept as you are already in a faction.
CREATE_FACTION_CONFLICT: The proposed faction could not be formed because one of us is already bound by other treaties.
PUPPET_CANNOT_MAKE_PEACE: A subject state cannot settle a war on its own authority. Take it up with our overlord.
PUPPET_CANNOT_CHOOSE_FACTION: A subject state does not choose its own alliances. Address our overlord.
NO_WAR_TO_JOIN: There is no war between us to answer for. Whatever pact you think binds us here, it does not.
